text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many important decisions. One key choice is between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one platform, like iOS or Android, and often offer the best performance. Cross-platform apps work on several platforms at once, which saves time and money. Responsive design is also essential, because users expect apps to look good on different screen sizes. After development, apps are usually published through app stores, such as Google Play or the App Store. However, performance remains a major concern. Slow or buggy apps lose users quickly, so developers must test carefully and optimise their code before release.
